name: FoomLottery Groth16 degenerate-verifier proof forgery
summary: FoomLottery's withdraw Groth16 verifier was deployed with gamma and delta set to the same G2 point because the trusted-setup Phase 2 contribution was skipped, so the pairing check no longer binds the public inputs. Anyone could forge collect() proofs for fresh nullifiers; the attacker looped forged collects to drain the Base lottery, and copycats hit the Base and Ethereum lotteries.
notes: Ethereum 0xce204482 (19.70T FOOM) is excluded as an affiliated rescue (rule 5): its sender, 0x46c403e3, returned 17.73T FOOM to the FOOM deployer 2.5 hours later and kept about 10% as a bounty. The anchor's FOOM was bridged away, not returned.

The campaign is every forged collect() on the Base lottery and the live Ethereum lottery 0x239af915 (verifier 0xc043865f, also gamma = delta) after the anchor, apart from the rescue. These are the contract-driven collects plus EOA 0x53424f36's halving-amount loop; the remaining collects went through the relayer 0x67b184fe or came before the anchor.
FOOM is priced at DefiLlama's price when it moved. The thin market means realised proceeds were lower.
